name: Stairs
summary: Indoor wooden staircase rising to the right with a banister and rail posts. Use flip to make it rise to the left.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the first step: the stairs rest on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the run is about 900 px wide

params.name: anim
params.note: motion only; driven by the frame

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror: rises to the left instead

author: krakujs
